Why asking "how" too soon can stall a goal.

Kevin explains that when people name what they want, many jump straight to "How am I going to get that?" He calls that a failure habit.

His point: at the start, your only job is to define clearly what you want, not to figure out the method.

What do you do first when a big goal feels out of reach?

#ad #goals #mindset #kevintrudeau

Why Carnegie had one answer ready for everyone.

Kevin explains that when anyone asked Andrew Carnegie what he wanted, he gave the same sentence every time: to build the largest, most profitable steel company in the world.

Reporter or board member, the answer never changed. Kevin says it was ingrained in his mind.

Could you state what you want in one clear sentence, instantly?
